register_model: register a new model class with a unique name key using the registry decorator
register_task: register a new task class with a unique name key using the registry decorator
register_dataset: register a new dataset class with a unique name key using the registry decorator
get_class: get a registered class by name from a specific mapping like model or task
register_unregister: register an arbitrary object under a dot-separated key path and unregister it later
